edges.reason: transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for source and recipient.
Transfer authorization depends on allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance mapping for the caller and spender.
ensure() grants unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall.
_mints checks msg.sender against owner and hardcoded addresses.
init requires msg.sender == owner to change sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
ensure() bypasses condition() when _from == tradeAddress.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
ensure() returns true immediately when canSale[_from] is set.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound sales per address.
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure() to gate the transfer.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
delegate forwards the user-supplied bytes into a.delegatecall(b), executing arbitrary code in this contract's context.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop.
transferFrom authorizes msg.sender against allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve stores the allowance keyed by the caller msg.sender.
delegate's only guard is require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner and four hardcoded addresses.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner and initial balance to msg.sender.
_from is consumed by transferFrom for authorization and balance updates.
_to is consumed by transferFrom as the credit target.
_value drives all amount comparisons and balance mutations in transferFrom.
The bytes parameter b is passed directly to delegatecall.
spender receives minted balance and canSale whitelisting in _mints.
addedValue scales the minted balance written in _mints.
_tos provides the recipients iterated over by batchSend.
saleNum is written to _saleNum by init.
token and maxToken are scaled by 10**decimals with unchecked multiplication in init.
total is computed as _value * _tos.length without SafeMath in batchSend.
The locally derived _UNI pair address is compared against _from inside ensure().
The loop index i bounds the batchSend recipient iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: Source address parameter only flows into transferFrom and is folded into that function node.
Recipient address parameter is only consumed by transferFrom.
Amount parameter is bound to transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
The bytes argument is the direct input of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
spender is written into balanceOf and canSale only inside _mints.
addedValue determines the minted amount set by _mints.
Recipient array is iterated exclusively by batchSend.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init only.
token and maxToken limits are scaled and stored by init only.
The unchecked product local feeds the unsafe balanceOf[msg.sender] subtraction in batchSend.
The derived pair address is used solely for the whitelist comparison inside ensure.
Loop counter exists only to drive the batchSend iteration.
